title: Chicken and Northern Thai Spice Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the bold flavors of Northern Thailand with the simplicity of a stir fry.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and bamboo shoots to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Northern Thai spice, fish sauce, and sugar to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Serve the chicken and vegetables over sticky rice.
